# Isla Vida Mykonos

> Isla Vida Mykonos is a locally based private transfer, chauffeur and concierge company on the island of Mykonos, Greece, available 24/7. It provides private airport (JMK), port and cruise port transfers from €36 per vehicle in Mercedes vehicles, a private chauffeur by the hour, island tours, luxury villa rentals, yacht and helicopter charters, and beach club, restaurant and VIP table reservations.

## Key facts

- Business name: Isla Vida Mykonos (also "Isla Vida"; on Google Maps: "Isla Vida Mykonos Transfers & Concierge")
- Location: Mykonos, Cyclades, Greece. Serves the whole island.
- Website: https://www.islavidajmk.com
- Phone and WhatsApp: +30 694 804 1931 (https://wa.me/306948041931)
- Email: info@islavidajmk.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/islavida_mykonos/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=1373307275586565091
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Google rating: 5.0 from 74 reviews
- Prices: private transfers from €36 per vehicle (not per person). The final price depends on distance and the number of guests and is confirmed in writing before travel.
- Fleet: Premium SUV (up to 4 guests), Mercedes Vito (up to 8), Mercedes V-Class (up to 8), Mercedes Sprinter (up to 20). Child seats on request.
- Flights and ferries are tracked, so pickups adjust to delays.
- Payment: cash, card or payment link.
- Areas served: Mykonos Airport (JMK), New Port (Tourlos), Old Port, Mykonos Town (Chora), Ornos, Psarou, Platis Gialos, Agios Ioannis, Agios Lazaros, Paraga, Paradise, Super Paradise, Elia, Kalo Livadi, Kalafatis, Agios Stefanos, Ano Mera and all hotels and villas on the island.

## Transfers

- [Mykonos Airport Transfers](https://www.islavidajmk.com/mykonos-airport-transfers): Private transfers from Mykonos Airport (JMK) to any hotel or villa, from €36 per vehicle, with drive times to 14 areas and flight tracking.
- [Mykonos Port Transfers](https://www.islavidajmk.com/mykonos-port-transfers): Private transfers from Mykonos New Port and Old Port, with drive times to 15 areas and ferry tracking.
- [Mykonos Cruise Port Transfers](https://www.islavidajmk.com/mykonos-cruise-port-transfers): Private transfers and shore tours for cruise passengers, back well before all-aboard.
- [Services](https://www.islavidajmk.com/services): Airport and port transfers, chauffeur by the hour, island tours, group transportation, villas, yachts and helicopters.
- [Fleet](https://www.islavidajmk.com/fleet): Premium SUV, Mercedes Vito, Mercedes V-Class and Mercedes Sprinter.

## Villas

- [Villas](https://www.islavidajmk.com/villas): A collection of 26 private luxury villas across Mykonos, from 3 to 9 bedrooms, in Psarou, Agios Lazaros, Ornos, Kalafatis, Kalo Livadi, Super Paradise, Mykonos Town and more. Several villas allow private parties and events. Prices on request.

## Concierge

- [Concierge](https://www.islavidajmk.com/concierge): A 24/7 local concierge: villas, yachts, helicopters, private chefs, security, event and wedding planning, personal shopping and private transfers.
- [Beach Club Reservations](https://www.islavidajmk.com/concierge/beach-club-reservations): Sunbeds, cabanas and lunch tables at Nammos, Scorpios, Principote, Alemagou and more, including the LGBTQ+ friendly Jackie O' Beach and Elia Beach.
- [Restaurant Reservations](https://www.islavidajmk.com/concierge/restaurant-reservations): Tables at Interni, Noema, Lío Mykonos, Kastro's and more.
- [Sunset Bars](https://www.islavidajmk.com/concierge/sunset-bars): Tables at 180° Sunset Bar, Negrita, Scarpa, Cerise and Numi.
- [Nightlife & VIP Tables](https://www.islavidajmk.com/concierge/nightlife-vip-tables): VIP tables and nightlife planning, with a private driver for the night.

## Holidays

- [Mykonos Holidays](https://www.islavidajmk.com/holidays): Plan a whole Mykonos holiday with one local team.
- [From Dubai & the UAE](https://www.islavidajmk.com/holidays/uae-dubai): Discreet villas, chauffeur, halal dining and female staff on request.
- [From the USA & Mexico](https://www.islavidajmk.com/holidays/usa-mexico): Chauffeur at your disposal, beach club tables, party planning and Spanish-speaking staff on request.
- [From Israel](https://www.islavidajmk.com/holidays/israel): Kosher dining arranged, Shabbat-aware planning and a Jewish heritage tour of Delos.
